visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black jacket sits outdoors on a tan camping chair, sipping coffee from a patterned ceramic cup. He is positioned in front of a dark wooden wall featuring a large white board with a brush-painted tiger. The ground is covered in grey gravel, and several camping tables with coffee gear are visible in the foreground. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a cafe bar area. The man stands next to a professional espresso machine, pointing at it while speaking. Another man with grey hair and glasses, wearing a plaid shirt, enters the frame from the right. The background shows a clean kitchen with glass jars and coffee equipment under warm indoor lighting. (3) A series of close-up shots show the coffee preparation process. Hands are seen grinding coffee, tamping it into a portafilter, and extracting a dark espresso shot into a glass. The camera then focuses on milk being steamed and carefully poured into a black metal mug to create a heart-shaped latte art pattern. (4) The barista with glasses presents the finished cup of coffee on a counter. The camera moves in a first-person perspective to receive the drink. The scene pans to show the interior of the cafe, including a wall decorated with framed certificates and medals, and a glimpse of the kitchen sink area. (5) The two men are back outdoors, sitting at a black folding table under warm string lights at night. They gesture toward the camping furniture and the gravel ground. Close-ups feature specific items: a black mug with a cat logo, wooden trays holding macarons and chocolates, and a tan camping chair. Yellow text overlays appear consistently at the bottom.

Two male voices exchange short, casual phrases with light laughter overlapping. (4) The sound of liquid pouring into a cup creates a soft splashing texture. The BGM maintains its presence as the primary speaker's tone remains professional and welcoming. There is a very subtle shift in the background noise floor, suggesting a change in environment. The primary male voice continues a linear narrative, punctuated by the rhythmic strumming of the acoustic guitar. The track concludes with a final hard cut of both the music and the voice.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to promote a specific cafe called '虎咖啡' (Hu Cafe) in Yilan, while simultaneously endorsing 'CAMPFIRE' brand camping gear used in the cafe's outdoor seating area. It uses a personal vlog style to create a warm, inviting atmosphere that appeals to coffee lovers and camping enthusiasts.
